# Hour of Code

> Hour of Code is a global initiative dedicated to introducing students to computer science and artificial intelligence through accessible, hands-on learning activities.

The site provides Hour of AI and Hour of Code programs designed to engage students of all ages in computer science education. It offers localized resources, teacher materials, and student activities across multiple regions and partner organizations including 4-H, Code.org, and CSforAll.

## Key Topics

- Hour of AI

- [The Hour of AI](https://hourofcode.com/hr/ru/learn?subject=ai): Hour of AI hands-on activities for student computer science learning
